import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix island label variants
    island_map = {"Torgerson": "Torgersen", "Bisco": "Biscoe"}
    df["island"] = df["island"].replace(island_map)
    # fix sex case variants
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    # parse body_mass_g which is stored as text with commas
    df["body_mass_g"] = df["body_mass_g"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(df["body_mass_g"], errors="coerce")
    # drop out of range body mass
    df = df[(df["body_mass_g"] >= 2500) & (df["body_mass_g"] <= 6500)]
    # ensure numeric columns are numeric
    for col in ["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "year"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")
    # keep only allowed categorical values
    df = df[df["species"].isin(["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"])]
    df = df[df["island"].isin(["Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"])]
    df = df[df["sex"].isin(["male", "female"])]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # assume df is cleaned; ensure body_mass_g numeric just in case
    tmp = df.copy()
    if tmp["body_mass_g"].dtype == object:
        tmp["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(tmp["body_mass_g"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False), errors="coerce")
    means = tmp.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean()
    return {species: float(mean) for species, mean in means.items()}
